items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Context menu on Base UI ContextMenu: opens at the pointer on right click or long press, and from the keyboard with Shift+F10 or the ContextMenu key. Menu-like rows (selected row inverts, arrow cursor), items, link items, checkbox and radio items, groups, submenus, optional arrow.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Compose ContextMenu, ContextMenuTrigger (focusable area: give it aria-label or text), ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuLinkItem, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuSub + ContextMenuSubTrigger, ContextMenuCheckboxItem, ContextMenuRadioGroup + ContextMenuRadioItem, ContextMenuGroup + ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuShortcut. Styles are self-contained (no menu item needed). Popup uses yorha-pop. V4: scroll body with cue, pixel arrow, shortcut prop (display only), -webkit-touch-callout none on the trigger.
